verdict.rationale: Ollama's docs have an endpoint reference with copyable curl examples and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec. However, a probe found the Mintlify in-page playground is configured to the 'simple' display, so no 'Try it' runner renders on any endpoint page. No vendor page documents an interactive explorer. Static curl snippets and a spec a user could load into another tool are adjacent building blocks or workarounds, not the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
